evidence: Cic. Fam. 13.73.2: potest fierī, ut fallar
Traupman 61: cum prīmum fierī potest, as soon as possible
terms.comment: Sī fierī potest, or just sī potest, if possible (Traupman 84, 212; Cato); fierī nōn potest ut, it cannot be that.

terms.gloss: as … as possible; quam prīmum, as soon as possible
evidence: Traupman 55: quam prīmum, as soon as possible

terms.comment: Quintilian’s rendering of Greek δυνατόν in rhetoric, later a legal term; everyday Latin says fierī potest.

phrases.latin: ego vērō tē quam prīmum, mea vīta, cupiō vidēre
phrases.english: I want to see you as soon as possible, my darling

phrases.latin: vōs, meae cārissimae animae, quam saepissimē ad mē scrībite
phrases.english: my dearest hearts, write to me as often as you can

phrases.latin: fundum eōdem diē, sī potest, circumeat
phrases.english: let him walk round the farm the same day, if possible

phrases.latin: fierī nōn potest ut fīlius istārum lacrimārum pereat
phrases.english: it cannot be that the son of these tears should be lost
